english.title: Fail to operate rhythmic lighting regime in housing for conventionally reared meat chickens - Wales
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or excuse, were responsible for conventionally reared meat chickens at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) when, within 7 days from the time when the chickens were placed in the house and until 3 days before the expected time of slaughter, the lighting did not follow a 24-hour rhythm and include periods of darkness lasting at least 6 hours in total, with at least one uninterrupted period of darkness of at least 4 hours, excluding dimming periods
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 5(1)(ba), 7(1)(a) and 9 of, and paragraph 10(3) of Schedule 5A to, the Welfare of Farmed Animals (Wales) Regulations 2007.

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, without lawful authority or excuse, was responsible for conventionally reared meat chickens at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) when, within 7 days from the time when the chickens were placed in the house and until 3 days before the expected time of slaughter, the lighting did not follow a 24-hour rhythm and include periods of darkness lasting at least 6 hours in total, with at least one uninterrupted period of darkness of at least 4 hours, excluding dimming periods.

other.penalty:
Summary: 51 weeks imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Note
In relation to an offence committed before section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the reference to 51 weeks imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
